error-battle.md.content:
# Error-Battle
// REAL-TIME CP DUELS

A multiplayer competitive-programming arena built around Codeforces.
{green}1v1{/green} / {cyan}1vN{/cyan} battles with room synchronization, live chat,
and problem assignment based on what players actually want to solve.

STACK   : Next.js / Node.js / Socket.io / MongoDB
STATUS  : {green}100+ users → 10K+ interactions{/green}

neermitra.md.content:
# NEERMITRA AI
// GROUNDWATER × GENAI

Built for Smart India Hackathon to make government groundwater data
actually understandable. Users ask naturally; {magenta}Gemini{/magenta} interprets it,
{cyan}LangChain + FastAPI{/cyan} fetch the right INGRES data, and the system turns it
back into a human-friendly answer.

STACK   : Next.js / FastAPI / LangChain / Gemini / INGRES
STATUS  : {yellow}Hackathon build → deployed MVP{/yellow}

ai-vue.md.content:
# AI-Vue
// AI-POWERED MOCK INTERVIEWS

Started with a simple question: what if an interview could actually adapt
to the person answering it? AI-Vue uses an LLM pipeline to generate questions,
evaluate responses, and turn conversations into structured feedback.

STACK   : Next.js / LangChain.js / MongoDB / JWT

varta-raksha.md.content:
# Varta-Raksha
// VOICE × AI × SECURITY

An AI voice-analysis pipeline built to examine whether a voice is synthetic
and understand the context behind the conversation. Combines voice detection,
speaker matching, transcription, and scam-context analysis into one workflow.

STACK   : Python / FastAPI / Whisper / PyTorch / Ollama
